question: In how many years did total US CO2 exceed 6,000 Mt? (A) 13 (B) 4 (C) 8. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the climate stacked_bar chart. The y-axis runs to 5x the largest stack. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): inappropriate axis range. True answer: B (4). Bait: A (13).
